local_dev_payload_observations.qualification: Local development responses; uncompressed transfer and production performance were not inferred.

findings.title: Scenario selection is cosmetic
findings.acceptance_gate: Every supported case kind has concrete input and its own trace; cloned traces require an approved equivalence disposition.

findings.title: Action View has no binding to lesson Python
findings.acceptance_gate: 100% visual events resolve to a current code artifact hash and stable source span.

findings.title: Stage 7 event vocabulary policy was not enforced
findings.acceptance_gate: Zero unknown labels and zero label-to-event-type mismatches.

findings.title: Runtime state records are largely templated
findings.acceptance_gate: Before/delta/after and output are scenario-specific, concrete and reviewed; conceptual records are explicitly labeled.

findings.title: Stage 9 compiler loses theory structure and mixes evidence with source
findings.acceptance_gate: 26/26 lessons preserve accepted knowledge units and direct coursebook/syllabus/exam joins.

findings.title: Imported JSON bypasses runtime schema validation
findings.acceptance_gate: Source and generated artifacts validate against one versioned schema; negative fixtures fail precisely.

findings.title: Automated gates emphasize counts and source-text tokens rather than behavior
findings.acceptance_gate: Unit, integration, browser and accessibility tests detect cloned scenarios, stale line bindings and false renderer semantics.

findings.title: Verification commands mutate generated artifacts
findings.acceptance_gate: All verify/check commands are read-only and leave a clean worktree.

findings.title: Release manifest composition is unstable and incomplete
findings.acceptance_gate: An allow-listed build bill of materials covers every build input and a detached clean copy passes rebuild plus smoke tests.

findings.title: Runtime registry and hub payload are oversized
findings.acceptance_gate: Registry is partitioned and measured production payloads satisfy approved budgets.

findings.title: Server-rendered deployment versus static/offline delivery is undecided
findings.acceptance_gate: Deployment target is documented and reproduced in CI.

findings.title: Accessibility implementation has a good base but incomplete semantic and automated coverage
findings.acceptance_gate: Zero serious/critical axe findings, correct headings, human-readable predictions, full keyboard path, 320 px and 400% zoom pass.

findings.title: Local Node and process workflow is not pinned
findings.acceptance_gate: Node 22 is pinned in developer workflow and CI; health check and production-start smoke are scripted.

release_gates.G0: Read-only baseline audit; repeated run leaves worktree unchanged.
release_gates.G1: All source/generated artifacts validate; negative fixtures fail precisely.
release_gates.G2: 26/26 canonical Python examples compile/run and link to run evidence.
release_gates.G3: 100% events bind to current source spans; event vocabulary clean; scenarios are truthful.
release_gates.G4: Runtime uses selected scenario trace and synchronizes real code/state/output accessibly.
release_gates.G5: Measured production payloads satisfy approved budgets; full registry is not shipped to hub client.
release_gates.G6: 26/26 lessons preserve theory and direct source joins; generated outputs are deterministic.
release_gates.G7: 52 routes and 58 patterns pass behavior, accessibility, keyboard and mobile checks.
release_gates.G8: Clean Node 22 checkout rebuild and detached release verification pass with a clean worktree.

lead_next_actions: Approve schema v2 and source/generated directory boundaries.
Produce five vertical slices with actual run evidence and code-span bindings.
Require independent G7 QA before bulk rollout and release.
Relock only after G0 through G8 are green.
